messages:
emma (Partnerships): Heads-up 1: partner sync scheduled Thu. Need clear inputs: reserved vs spot allocation, marketplace fee tagging, and how onboarding credits are applied.
raj (Finance): Do we have their preferred allocation plan? They mentioned a flexible band but no concrete numbers in the deck.
sophie (Sales): Partner deck showed a sample 60/40 reserved/spot for first 90 days, with credits stacked against reserved. They verbally said they'd consider other mixes.
michael (SRE): For ops we need eviction cadence and regional deltas. If spot eviction rate >15% in a region, we should stop auto-upgrading to reserved there until it stabilizes. Otherwise billing and routing get messy.
emma (Partnerships): Proposal: implement a damping rule: if region eviction increases by >10% week-over-week, pause auto-conversions and alert finance + partnerships. Sound reasonable?
raj (Finance): Sounds right. Also request: granular marketplace fee field per SKU. Partner-managed marketplace fees can materially change unit economics if charged on reserved SKUs only.
emma (Partnerships): I'll ask them to send CSV with these headers: sku, region, reserved_price_monthly, spot_price_hourly, marketplace_fee_pct, eviction_rate_est_30d, commit_weeks_to_full. Need it by Wed EOD.
sophie (Sales): I'll chase them. Also confirm: onboarding credits apply to reserved-only? Partner prefers that. If so, sales messaging needs clarity.
julia (Legal): If credits are reserved-only we must reflect that in contract language and the invoice layout. I'll prepare an addendum template.
michael (SRE): Operational note: conversion should be atomic w.r.t. routing and billing to avoid double-billing. We should add a flag in the billing pipeline when conversions occur.
ops-bot: feature-flag created: partner_spot_damping. Use /ops deploy to rollout.
raj (Finance): For modeling I'll run three mixes: conservative (40% reserved), baseline (60%), optimistic (80%). Overlay marketplace_fee scenarios: 0%, 5%, 10%. I'll include stochastic eviction in Monte Carlo.
emma (Partnerships): Can you output a CSV per SKU with scenario outcomes by Thu noon? Fields: sku, scenario, reserved_hours_monthly, spot_hours_monthly, avg_unit_cost_usd, marketplace_fee_usd, notes.
raj (Finance): Yep. Will include expected variance from eviction volatility.
sophie (Sales): Sales would like a short ARR impact blurb per scenario for AEs. One-pager after finance model is fine.
julia (Legal): Partner requested a 24hr "graceful eviction" clause around reserved conversions. That's atypical; proposing we counter with 72hr minimum. I'll draft language.
michael (SRE): 72hrs aligns better with our capacity and autoscaler tuning. Also request partner provide per-region eviction CSV sample so we can feed it into the autoscaler: ```sku,region,eviction_rate_30d,median_recovery_minutes,preemptible_window```
emma (Partnerships): Adding that field to the CSV spec. Also adding commit_weeks_to_full so ops knows ramp timing.
ops-bot: reminder created: partner_csv_deadline at 2190001600 (Wed 09:00 UTC).
emma (Partnerships): Action list: 1) Emma: send CSV spec to partner by EOD Wed. 2) Raj: deliver Monte Carlo CSV by Thu 12:00. 3) Michael: ops gating checklist + ensure flag safe. 4) Julia: draft addendum + SLA credit clause. 5) Sophie: prepare sales one-pager after model.
raj (Finance): Also I'll include a column for marketplace_fee_abs_usd to make comparisons easier for AEs.
sophie (Sales): If partner accepts >=72hr notice and clear fee pass-through, sales will push for enterprise case studies in the pitch. :thumbsup:
emma (Partnerships): Great. I'll post the sent CSV template here once it's out. Thanks everyone.
